sentences.zh: 她说，真正受审的是那些企图推翻大选结果的人。

sentences.en: And that was one of the moments that really sort of sent a real kind of shock through the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 这也是真正让法庭为之震惊的时刻之一。

sentences.en: You have this melodrama, this kind of footnote that's now ballooned into its own story.
sentences.zh: 你们有这种如情节剧般的插曲，现在这个插曲已经膨胀成了一个独立的故事。

sentences.en: And it was a very interesting moment of kind of redirecting the flow of the conversation back to very fundamental questions about democracy and efforts to subvert it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的时刻，它把对话的方向重新引导回了关于民主以及颠覆民主努力的非常根本的问题上。

sentences.en: Richard, by the end of this testimony, Yurdy, Wade, Willis, a pretty complicated portrait has
sentences.zh: 理查德，到这段证词快结束时，尤迪、韦德、威利斯，勾勒出了一个相当复杂的画像

sentences.en: emerged of this relationship that's now at the center of these questions of whether this case involving democracy moves forward.
sentences.zh: 这段关系现在成了核心问题，关乎这起涉及民主的案件是否能继续推进。

sentences.en: I mean, this one witness says the relationship starts before Willis hired Wade, but it's just her word.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这位证人说这段关系在威利斯雇用韦德之前就开始了，但这只是她的一面之词。

sentences.en: There's no hard evidence.
sentences.zh: 没有什么确凿的证据。

sentences.en: And Wade and Willis, under oath, disagree.
sentences.zh: 而韦德和威利斯在宣誓后对此予以否认。

sentences.en: It becomes clear that Wade did pay for a lot of travel for Willis.
sentences.zh: 很明显，韦德确实为威利斯的很多行程付了钱。

sentences.en: And yet Willis says she reimbursed him, but there's no evidence that either of them can produce to verify that.
sentences.zh: 然而威利斯说她已经还钱了，但双方都拿不出证据来证实这一点。

sentences.en: So there aren't really smoking guns in either direction.
sentences.zh: 所以两边其实都没有确凿的铁证。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: I mean, what we do know is that we're going to have a lot more testimony.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们确实知道接下来还会有大量的证词。

sentences.en: We're going to have more witnesses who will probably be called.
sentences.zh: 我们还会有可能会被传唤更多的证人。

sentences.en: But I do think that this has given Donald Trump and his allies the ability to create a kind of plume of suspicion that there were bad intentions behind this case.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，这让唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友得以制造出一团怀疑的阴云，让人觉得这个案件背后有不良动机。

sentences.en: And I think we should think about what the real practical ramifications of that issue are.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该思考一下这个问题真正的现实后果是什么。

sentences.en: And by an issue, I mean a public relations loss for the district attorney's office.
sentences.zh: 我所说的问题，是指地方检察官办公室面临的公关损失。

sentences.en: It has a real material, potential material effect because the jury that sits to decide whether or not Donald Trump broke the law in Georgia will come from Fulton County.
sentences.zh: 这会产生切实的影响，潜在的实质性影响，因为负责裁决唐纳德·特朗普在佐治亚州是否触犯法律的陪审团将来自富尔顿县。

sentences.en: And if they continue to read headlines that say that something is fishy about Fonnie Willis
sentences.zh: 如果他们继续读到那些称法妮·威利斯

sentences.en: and her boyfriend or ex-boyfriend and their travel, you could potentially see a greater possibility
sentences.zh: 和她的男友或前男友以及他们的旅行有些可疑的头条新闻，你可能会看到一种更大的可能性

sentences.en: that at the very least one of those 12 future jurors decides that something is too fishy for them to vote guilty.
sentences.zh: 那就是这12名未来的陪审团成员中，至少会有人觉得事情太可疑了，从而无法投有罪票。

sentences.en: And in that way, this entire drama is extremely relevant no matter what the judge rules in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，无论法官在未来几天作出什么裁决，整场闹剧都极其重要。

sentences.en: In other words, no matter what the judge decides, whether he keeps them on the case or just qualifies
sentences.zh: 换句话说，无论法官做出什么决定，无论他是让他们继续留在案子里，还是取消

sentences.en: Willis and Wade, something about this case in its fundamental mission has been altered here and maybe weakened.
sentences.zh: 威利斯和韦德的资格，这个案件的根本使命已经在这里被改变了，也许还被削弱了。

sentences.en: I think that's possible.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是可能的。

sentences.en: And one of the things I find so remarkable is that we've all thought of the Georgia case is one that really couldn't be touched by Donald Trump if he were to be reelected.
sentences.zh: 我发现极其remarkable（注：原文未完，按语境翻译）的一点是，我们过去都认为佐治亚州的案子是唐纳德·特朗普如果再次当选也绝对无法触及的。

sentences.en: He couldn't pardon himself.
sentences.zh: 他无法特赦自己。

sentences.en: He couldn't direct his future attorney general to dismiss the case.
sentences.zh: 他无法直接命令他未来的司法部长撤销这个案子。

sentences.en: And yet, here we are with this threat to the Georgia case that's coming from a very different place.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们现在却面临着对佐治亚州案件的这种威胁，而它来自一个完全不同的地方。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's coming from what some people would argue would be a lapse in judgment.
sentences.zh: 这来自于某些人所说的判断失误。

sentences.en: It's almost unfathomable to imagine that a history could be bent by something like that.
sentences.zh: 很难想象历史竟然会被这样的事情所扭曲。

sentences.en: But here we are.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在确实面临这样的局面。

sentences.en: Well, Richard, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，理查德，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: The hearing is scheduled to resume this morning, with Fonnie Willis expected to return to the stand.
sentences.zh: 听证会预计于今天上午恢复，法妮·威利斯预计将重返证人席。

sentences.en: A ruling on whether she and Nathan Wade should be removed from the case is expected in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 预计在未来几周内，将对她和内森·韦德是否应被排除在案件之外做出裁决。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 纽约的一名法官已正式将针对唐纳德·特朗普的第一起刑事审判

sentences.en: to begin on March 25th, ensuring that the former president will face at least one jury before Election Day.
sentences.zh: 定于3月25日开庭，这确保了这位前总统将在大选日前至少面对一个陪审团。

sentences.en: That trial, led by the Manhattan District Attorney, will focus on allegations that Trump falsified business records during his 2016 presidential campaign
sentences.zh: 该审判由曼哈顿地方检察官领导，将聚焦于特朗普在2016年总统竞选期间

sentences.en: in order to hide a sexual relationship with an adult film star.

sentences.en: And police in Kansas City said they believed that a dispute between teenagers was the cause of a mass shooting at a Super Bowl victory celebration
sentences.zh: 堪萨斯城警方表示，他们认为青少年之间的争端是超级碗夺冠庆祝活动上发生大规模枪击事件的原因

sentences.en: that injured nearly two dozen people and killed a 43-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 该事件导致近二十人受伤，并造成一名43岁女性死亡。

sentences.en: Police identified that woman as Elizabeth Galvin, a local DJ whose son was also shot in the leg during the gunfire.
sentences.zh: 警方确认该女性为伊丽莎白·加尔文，是一名当地DJ，她的儿子在枪击中腿部也中弹了。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。
